decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and coating know-how, so it can readily interpret field results and refine the product, though it has only been mentioned and not presented on its own page.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established offer, has its own page, and was field-tested on a construction site, which shows the firm is learning from its use and applying it commercially.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses the proven WIWA air motors, so it builds directly on existing components and knowledge, keeping risk and adaptation effort low.

Fire protection flow monitoring moves somewhat further from the core, but it has its own page and fits the firm's digitalization goals, where its own R&D and university cooperation give it the knowledge to develop the product further.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system is a recent launch very close to the core competence, so the firm can absorb market feedback efficiently and has every reason to keep developing it.
